rationale: The agent submitted the exchange without first confirming the order-changing actions with the user, which violates the stated policy. There is no clear evidence of an authentication step beyond user-provided details, and the conversation does not show a confirmation prompt before performing the write (exchange_delivered_order_items). The agent also stated specific refund and payment details after executing the exchange. Even if product selections align with the user's preferences (clicky, full-size, fallback to no backlight; Google Assistant-compatible thermostat), the lack of confirmation prior to making changes and unclear authentication result in a policy failure.
